notes: «حدثنا ابن أبي عمر، وأحمد بن منيع» are co-transmitters of one level («قالا» then continues the same chain), so one group
«أبيه» is Salim's father, the Companion, not named in this report
«- المعنى واحد -» is an editor's gloss: left out. «قال أحمد بن منيع في حديثه» is a wording version with no new transmitter; «وفي الباب» is the compiler's remark
